questions.q: What was Mr. Utterson's attitude towards drinking alcohol?
questions.explain: Mr. Utterson never drank alcohol when he was alone.

questions.q: How did Mr. Utterson react to the misdeeds of his acquaintances?
questions.explain: Mr. Utterson often helped downgoing men in need.

questions.q: What did Mr. Utterson believe in?
questions.explain: Mr. Utterson had an approved tolerance for others and often helped them in their misdeeds.

questions.q: What did Mr. Utterson avoid doing for twenty years?
questions.explain: Mr. Utterson avoided going to the theatre for twenty years.

questions.q: How did Mr. Utterson treat people he cared about?
questions.explain: Mr. Utterson was lovable and had a tolerant attitude towards others.

questions.q: What did Mr. Utterson say to show his tolerance for others?
choices: I let my brother go to the devil in his own way
I drink gin to mortify a taste for vintages
questions.explain: Mr. Utterson used this phrase to express his tolerance.
